test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What did the young farmers do when they came to the village?

options.text: They started using traditional farming methods.
They started a new business in the village.
They left the village soon after arriving.
They started using modern farming techniques and equipment.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Explanation:** The passage mentions,** "One day, a group of young farmers came to the village and started using modern farming techniques and equipment."**
 
• This clearly indicates what the young farmers did upon their arrival.</li&
